name: Vermont
summary: Statutes: legislature.vermont.gov per-section pages (unofficial, 2026 session) need a title-index hop for the chapter, which the index shows as section ranges; Justia 2025 is a WebFetch-only fallback; act PDFs are constructible. Constitution: one legislature page (heading stale but text current). Court rules: full text only in the LexisNexis free-access JavaScript app, which neither tool can read; the judiciary posts promulgation orders for recent amendments. Admin code: official CVR is the same Lexis app; Cornell LII mirrors it; SOS posts proposed-rule notices. Case law: vtcourts.gov library (Supreme Court from ~2006, trial divisions) is searchable by plain GET; public-domain cites 'YYYY VT N, ¶ P'; Justia covers 1950 on.

citation_map.notes: Statutes: Vermont style is '12 V.S.A. § 512'; Bluebook 'Vt. Stat. Ann. tit. 12, § 512'. Titles carry letter suffixes (9A UCC, 11A business corporations, 11B, 11C). In-code cross-references read 'section 512 of this title' and carry no state marker: route them only with Vermont context. Bare 'section N of Title T' is not claimed here (it would collide with Delaware's 'Section 141(k) of Title 8'); the prose forms routed here name 'the Vermont Statutes Annotated'. A '§§ 1131-1133' range is a span, not a hyphenated section; hyphenated sections exist only in Title 9A (UCC article-section, e.g. 2-101) and dotted ones in 11A/11B/11C (8.30). Session laws are cited 'YYYY, No. N (Adj. Sess.), § S' (the year is the session year; even-year adjourned sessions are '(Adj. Sess.)'). Bare 'YYYY, No. N' and 'Act N of YYYY' are generic and need Vermont context. Constitution: two chapters; Chapter I is cited by article ('ch. I, art. 11'), Chapter II by section ('ch. II, § 28'). Historic ordinal forms ('Article 11th') appear in older opinions. Court rules: V.R.C.P., V.R.Cr.P., V.R.A.P., V.R.E., V.R.F.P., V.R.P.P., V.R.E.C.P., V.R.Pr.C. (professional conduct); bare 'Rule 12(b)(6)' must not route here without context. Case law: public-domain citation 'YYYY VT N, ¶ P' since 2003 (paragraph-numbered pinpoints, vendor-neutral); parallel cites to Vt. (official Vermont Reports) and A.2d/A.3d. Unpublished three-justice entry orders (V.R.A.P. 33.1) carry only the docket ('No. 25-AP-364') and are not precedent. Supreme Court dockets: 'YY-AP-NNN' from about 2021; earlier 'YYYY-NNN'. The opinion PDF names derive from the docket (op25-345.pdf; eo25-364.pdf; eo2008-164.pdf; suffixes like '_3' or '.bail_' occur), so go through the library search. Superior Court dockets 'YY-CV-NNNNN' etc. are generic. CourtListener ids 'vt' and 'vtsuperct' are from memory and unverified.

sources.title: The Vermont Statutes Online
sources.publisher: Vermont General Assembly / Office of Legislative Counsel
sources.official_status_evidence: Every statute page: 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' (https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/12/023/00512). The official V.S.A. is the LexisNexis print edition.
sources.coverage: All titles of the V.S.A. including appendices (3, 10, 16, 24 Appendix); per-section HTML pages and whole-chapter pages; current through the latest session.

access.pattern_rules: title = 2-digit zero-padded plus any letter suffix (01, 09, 12, 09A, 11A). chapter = 3-digit zero-padded plus any suffix (023, 063, 002A). section = numeric part zero-padded to 5 digits, lower-case letter suffix kept (00512, 02453, 02451a). Title 9A (UCC) '§ 2-101' → chapter = article (002), section = part after the hyphen (00101). Titles 11A/11B/11C decimal sections '§ 8.30' → chapter 008, section '00008.30'. The CHAPTER is not encoded in the citation: take it from the title index, whose chapter rows show section ranges ('Chapter 023 : Limitation of Time for Commencement of Actions Contains: §§ 461 - 595'). A wrong chapter returns HTTP 200 with an empty shell '(Cite as: V.S.A. )' — treat that as not found. Whole chapter: https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/fullchapter/{title}/{chapter}.
access.navigation: title index (/statutes/title/12) → the chapter whose 'Contains: §§ a - b' range covers the section → chapter page (/statutes/chapter/12/023) lists per-section links → section page. Verified: 12 V.S.A. § 512 → /section/12/023/00512; 9 V.S.A. § 2453 → /section/09/063/02453; 13 V.S.A. § 2301 → /section/13/053/02301; 9A V.S.A. § 2-101 → /section/09A/002/00101; 11A V.S.A. § 8.30 → /section/11A/008/00008.30.

automation.notes: Crawl-delay 30 s: fetch_doc.py waits ~30 s between requests to this host. WebFetch reads section pages from search results (12/027/01131: complete, repeal note); a built URL (09/063/02453) was gated on the permission prompt. Pages are small (6-8K chars); the section text sits after ~4.7K chars of navigation.

sources.title: Opinions, Decisions and Order Library (Vermont Judiciary)
sources.official_status_evidence: Opinion PDFs: 'subject to motions for reargument under V.R.A.P. 40 as well as formal revision before publication in the Vermont Reports.'
sources.coverage: Supreme Court opinions and three-justice entry orders (sparse 2003-2005; full listing pages from 2006), plus Superior Court Civil, Criminal, Family, Probate and Environmental Division decisions. Library pages for 1998 and 2001 return no Supreme Court items.

access.pattern_rules: Plain GET (verified with WebFetch and fetch_doc). Facets: court_division_opinions_library_ 7=Supreme, 1=Civil, 2=Criminal, 3=Environmental, 4=Family, 6=Probate; add f%5B1%5D=document_type%3A94 for Opinions (92 Decisions, 93 Judgements, 96 Orders). Date range: facet_from_date=MM/DD/YYYY&facet_to_date=MM/DD/YYYY. Search matches docket ('25-AP-345', '2015-376') and party name ('Polomsky'); a public-domain cite ('2026 VT 44') does NOT resolve to one row. Result rows link /media/{id}, which redirects to /sites/default/files/documents/{name}.pdf (Supreme: op{yy}-{seq}.pdf, eo{yy}-{seq}.pdf, eo{yyyy}-{seq}.pdf with occasional suffixes; trial: free-form names). The host vermontjudiciary.org redirects to vtcourts.gov.

automation.notes: Supreme Court opinion PDFs are 20-50K chars and fit one WebFetch window (2026 VT 44 complete to ¶ 38).

hazards: slip opinions: Vermont Reports page numbers absent (pinpoint by ¶, which is official)
entry orders of three-justice panels are not precedent

script_candidates.why: Drupal search_api GET with facets (court, document type, date range) and docket/party keywords returns stable rows → /media/{id} → PDF; resolves (court, docket, date) deterministically.
JSON listing /bill/loadBillActs/{biennium}/regular gives ActNo → ActLink PDF for every act of a biennium.
Title index pages carry 'Contains: §§ a - b' per chapter: a one-time crawl of ~40 title pages makes every section URL constructible (crawl-delay 30 s).
